independence: Read all five author pages in the official hearing bundle and independently opened the primary Bertelsmann PDF; checked operational definition, sample restrictions, non-search reasons and full conclusions. No reliance on another agent's summary for the substantive determination.

checks.result: The paragraph explicitly attributes the majority proposition to a current Bertelsmann survey. In context the object is labour-market placement, with an adjacent Swedish job-search parenthesis. A benign shorthand reading equating lack of interest with non-search is possible, but the report does not operationalise interest that way: p13 expressly distinguishes independent search from jobcentre proposals. Thus a narrow source-description mismatch survives; actual recipient motivation is not established.

No bibliographic footnote identifies the survey. December2025 publication and the adjacent matching quarter-financial-incentives result make identification strong but still inferential. Retain this limitation prominently rather than claiming a uniquely proven citation match.

Primary p7 specifies ages25–50, at least one year of receipt, currently unemployed/jobseeking and not single parents. The author's unqualified recipient-wide formulation expands this scope. Do not infer the true population proportion from the restricted sample.

Primary p18 has multiple responses;74% of non-searchers report health reasons. This is context against treating non-search as a direct motivational result, not proof that health is the sole cause or that all non-searchers want a job. Primary pp34–36 also expressly discuss incentives, subjective obstacles, possible rationalisations and stronger early contact; those do not rescue attribution of a measured majority-disinterest result.

Author pp168–171 clearly endorses compulsory public-benefit work extended to private businesses. The majority-disinterest premise directly explains why existing placement efforts supposedly fail, so major is defensible for a source-description issue central to that explanation. It does not invalidate the entire policy case, which invokes separate mechanisms and international comparisons.

required_wording_limits: Describe only what the matched survey measures; do not say the actual majority is interested in work.
Keep survey identification and the loose-shorthand/antecedent alternative explicit.
Keep health results as non-exclusive self-reported context.
Do not treat general policy disagreement or missing evidence for actual attitudes as a separately proven factual error.

history.event: Independent adversarial review completed; retain a narrow source-description finding with attribution and interpretive limits.
